Console

The Wazoo Console is the web interface for managing your worlds, tokens, and graph data.

Features

Section titled “Features”

SPARQL editor

Run SPARQL queries against your worlds.

Import

Load RDF data into your worlds.

Search

Browse and find items in your worlds.

Tokens

Manage world-scoped API tokens.

Export

Download graph data in standard RDF formats.

Reindex

Check reindex availability and current behavior.
